nucleus_lineal_spectrum.note: nucleus-domain lineal spectrum sampled in the compartmented cell under the bound microdistribution; per-capture compound events (α+⁷Li), rectilinear CSDA tracks, unit-density tissue

validity_note: Stochastic sample under model "bpa-sato2018" (Sato et al. 2018 (Sci Rep 8:988) BPA compartment fractions: N_n=N_s=0 (amino-acid-transporter uptake distributes in cytoplasm, not nucleus), N_c=0.78, N_e=0.22 — intra/extra ≈ 3.2 measured for malignant cells. Concentric cell r=5 µm, nucleus r=3 µm matching their PHITS geometry (their concentric case).): straight CSDA tracks, constant LET, isotropic α/⁷Li back-to-back emission, Poisson captures, gamma uptake heterogeneity (CV = 0), unit-density nucleus. No straggling, no non-concentric geometry, no cell-to-cell track sharing beyond the extracellular shell.
